verdict.rationale: Phoenix documents an official CLI aimed at agent-driven workflows. `npx -y @arizeai/phoenix-cli setup` lets a coding agent set up tracing, `px setup mcp --agent claude` wires the CLI into coding agents, and `uvx arize-phoenix serve` starts the server from the terminal. Missing for 10: a full CLI command reference covering querying traces, datasets and experiments from the terminal, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Let your coding agent set up tracing for you: start Phoenix, then run `npx -y @arizeai/phoenix-cli setup` from your app's root directory.
px setup mcp --agent claude   # or codex, gemini, cursor, opencode, vscode
